title: Paloma and the Choir
author: Xanthe Montrose
blurb: Ada Brightwater, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
